summary.intent: Resume and complete the bookkeeping phase (plan 23-08) of a Rust SDK extraction project after a prior agent disconnected mid-execution.
summary.outcome: All acceptance criteria verified, summary and state files created/updated, and bookkeeping committed once 1Password SSH signing became available. Phase 23 marked complete in ROADMAP.md.

repo: Project uses a structured planning system under .planning/ with STATE.md, ROADMAP.md, per-phase VERIFICATION.md, and numbered SUMMARY.md files.
Phase 23 (rust-sdk-extraction) consists of 8 plans; the gap closure work (23-08) involved moving WinFsp files into the crate and delegating desktop logic.
Summaries are numbered sequentially (01-07 existed, 08 was missing) and follow a template at .claude/get-shit-done/templates/summary.md.
workflow: Agent reconnection pattern: check recent commits first to determine exactly where the prior agent left off before taking any action.
Staged files survive a failed commit attempt — retrying the commit without re-staging is safe.
1Password SSH signing failures are transient; retrying after user confirmation resolves them.

friction: Initial API connection failure (ConnectionRefused) caused agent disconnect mid-session, requiring manual resume.
1Password SSH agent failed to sign the commit three consecutive times before eventually succeeding after user returned and prompted a retry.
